properties.name: OBSERVED 2026-09-27 (config and code, not executed): an agent opened in cure's folder today is served cure's FROZEN laptop store as if it were the design, because the machine-wide entry opens any .reflow2/ it finds and nothing reads the freeze note; and the settled rules keep it that way once the pointer file exists (a folder's local store wins over the setting, and a folder with both is to refuse or warn)
properties.statement:
Found while walking Anthony through fact:a-moved-design-cannot-be-watched-and-its-frozen-export-reads-as-live-2026-09-27 with cure as the example, 2026-09-27.

WHAT IS THERE (measured): /home/ajs7/project/cure has no project .mcp.json; the only reflow2 entry an agent there gets is the machine-wide one in ~/.claude.json: `reflow2-mcp --graph-path .reflow2/graph --shared --only-if-present`. cure's .reflow2/ still holds the frozen store plus a human note, .reflow2/MOVED-TO-FLO2.md ("Do not open it with reflow2 to make changes: they would not reach the live design"). --only-if-present checks only latent::design_present(graph_path) (main.rs:1450). Nothing in reflow2-mcp, reflow2-core or tools/loop_nudge.py reads that note or any moved/frozen marker (grep).

⇒ INFERRED FROM THAT, NOT EXECUTED (opening the store would itself write to it): `claude` in cure's folder attaches to the frozen store. The agent sees a normal, complete design, reads the pre-move state, and its writes land in the backup the note says must never be written. Nothing tells it, or the person, that the live design is on flo2.io. The agent "does not know whether the design is local or remote", which req:a-local-client-works-against-a-remote-reflow2-server-by-url asks for, but here it is not knowing the wrong thing.

THE SETTLED RULES DO NOT CLOSE IT, AND ONE COMPOUNDS IT:
- dec:idea-one-command-switches-reflow2-between-local-and-remote: "a folder with a local store stays local. What the folder already holds always wins over the setting." A frozen store is a local store, so the setting cannot move cure's folder to flo2.io.
- dec:idea-a-repo-that-holds-its-design-moves-it-to-a-remote-server-once: "A folder with BOTH a live local store and a pointer to a remote design is ambiguous. The client should refuse or warn." After a move, every such folder has both, so every session would refuse or warn, unless the client can tell a FROZEN store from a live one.
- The pointer file (dec:idea-a-checkout-knows-which-remote-design-it-implements) is settled and unbuilt (cap:a-local-client-reaches-a-remote-server: "NOT YET: … the pointer file").

SAME CLASS as the watch finding: nothing distinguishes a snapshot left by a move from a live record, so every reader trusts it. The class guard proposed there, a moved design's local store and export SAYING they are frozen and where the design went, is what would let the client follow the pointer without asking and let the watch report the move. Fix NOT decided.
